summary: Iter61 — Frontend-only verification of the two chart visual changes (floating right-edge price labels; solid grid lines + future whitespace tail extending across empty area) against the LIVE VPS backend. Registered a fresh throwaway trader via VPS /api/auth/register, stored bfg_token in preview localStorage, opened /demo-trade. Verified: (1) NO regression on candle-close stability — with ZERO interaction, on 5s TF, monitored 33s (6+ candle closes) sampling every 3s: price-grid-labels children stayed at 9, price-grid-lines children stayed at 9-11 (dynamic band re-draw), canvas rect stable at x=64 w=1556 h=720 across all 11 samples, and time-axis labels advance smoothly as expected without any discrete jump at candle-close boundaries. (2) Floating price labels: price-grid-labels contains 9 visible children (e.g. 1.08300, 1.08400, 1.08500) floating at the right edge (right≈1614) OVER the chart area — no separate axis column; canvas extends the full 1556px including a large empty future region to the right of the live candle, and time labels continue into that future zone (e.g. 14:30 shown while now=14:27). (3) Grid lines are SOLID: borderTopStyle='solid', background=rgba(255,255,255,0.09), height=1px, backgroundImage='none' — dotted/hyphen style is gone. (4) Pan/zoom: dragging right made the jump-to-live-button appear; clicking it hid the button and returned newest candle ~near right edge (not lost in whitespace). (5) Timeframe switch (1m→5s→1m via dropdown) and pair switch (EUR/USD→GBP/USD (OTC), payout 88%) re-render correctly with no CRA error overlay and no 'Cannot update oldest data' console error. (6) candle-countdown ticks (00:09→00:02), live-price-tag updates (1.08398), live dashed price line visible. All 7 checkpoints PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: TradeChart.jsx price-grid computed style is now correctly SOLID (background rgba(255,255,255,0.09), height 1px) — matches the vertLines color used by lightweight-charts internally so DOM overlay and canvas grid stay visually consistent.

FUTURE_WS_BARS=300 whitespace tail keeps the right-side timeline populated so the live edge never becomes 'the end' — this is what prevents leftward re-flow at candle close. Confirmed no discrete jump across 6+ candle closes on 5s TF.
snapToLive() correctly parks the newest bar ~8 bars from the right edge (not in whitespace) — verified via jump-to-live button click after a right-pan.
No 'Cannot update oldest data' runtime error observed — historicalUpdate=true in the drain RAF loop is holding.
